pages.text: Personalize equipment through the working native route while preserving current deer curation.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: An ordinary Goat Horn works; disabled deer are unnecessary. Combine helmet and horn in an anvil; slot order chooses the decoration side. The other side can be decorated later. This is cosmetic, not extra armor.
